standard: ISO C (C99/C11/C17 baseline, C23 additions tracked separately)

classification_legend.IMPLEMENTED_BUNDLED: Compiled in this repo from bundled/upstream source (musl) or direct libc/src implementation; includes symbol_map VENDORED and IMPLEMENTED.
classification_legend.PLATFORM_BACKED: Namespaced cplus_* wrapper delegating to a named host C runtime backend; host semantics preserved.
classification_legend.PARTIAL: Only a subset of the header surface is available.
classification_legend.MISSING: No implementation in this repo and no host/namespaced wrapper entry point.
classification_legend.UNSUPPORTED: Deliberately not shipped; exact reason recorded in limitation.
classification_legend.HOST/COMPILER-PROVIDED: Toolchain/freestanding header or compile-time macro/type; no runtime symbol and not implemented by this library (task step 4).

notes: C17 (ISO/IEC 9899:2018) is a corrigendum to C11 and introduced no new library APIs; baseline APIs are tagged C89/C95/C99/C11.
C23 additions are tagged C23 and kept in the same per-header tables for completeness; stdckdint.h is out of scope.
Type and macro entries are classified HOST/COMPILER-PROVIDED because they are compile-time constructs defined by the toolchain header, even when a namespaced accessor exists.
Host probe (Apple Clang 16.0.0, arm64-apple-darwin): <threads.h> and <uchar.h> are NOT provided by the host toolchain (-std=c11 and -std=c17 both fail with "file not found").

Source/test/host-backend metadata is taken from libc/contracts/symbol_map.json and libc/contracts/c17_contracts.json, plus a scan of libc/src/**/*.c definitions and libc/install-include/cplus_libc.h declarations.

C23 tracking covers the explicitly named APIs (memset_explicit, strlcpy, strlcat, FE_TIESAWAY, timespec_getres, uchar char8_t/mbrtoc8/c8rtomb, atomic fetch_and/nand/wait/notify) plus representative new math families; the exhaustive _FloatN/_FloatNx overload matrix of C23 is not enumerated here. The C17 baseline surface is exhaustive.
